# Kyoto 5-Day Trip Plan for 2 Adults

A budget-conscious Kyoto plan for **2025-10-12 to 2025-10-16** that keeps walking under **12 km/day**, includes **temples, gardens, one food market visit**, and builds in **one low-cost, low-transit day**.
Budget target: **180,000 JPY total, excluding flights**.

## Trip Comparison and Budget Fit

| Option | Focus | Est. Daily Spend | Walking Load | Transit Load | Budget Fit |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| A | Temple-heavy classic Kyoto | 34,000–39,000 JPY | Moderate | Moderate | Strong |
| B | Garden + neighborhood balance | 31,000–36,000 JPY | Low–Moderate | Low | Best overall |
| C | Deep sightseeing with more taxis | 40,000–46,000 JPY | Moderate | High | Risky for budget |
| D | Ultra-low-cost reset day | 22,000–27,000 JPY | Low | Very low | Best for one day |

**Best fit:** **Option B** overall, with **Option D** used as your dedicated low-cost day.

## 5-Day Kyoto Itinerary Layout

### Day 1: Higashiyama Temple Loop
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka, Ninenzaka
- **Afternoon:** Kodai-ji and Maruyama Park
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/A199_Japan_Kyoto_Maruyama_Park_Gion_Ar%C3%A9a_%284764445344%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Kodai-ji and Maruyama Park, Kyoto, Japan
- **Evening:** Gion stroll, early dinner near Yasaka
- **Walking:** about 8–10 km
- **Cost level:** Medium

### Day 2: Arashiyama Gardens and Riverside
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning:** Tenryu-ji garden, bamboo grove
- **Afternoon:** Okochi Sanso Garden or river walk
- **Evening:** Return early; relaxed dinner in central Kyoto
- **Walking:** about 7–9 km
- **Cost level:** Medium

### Day 3: Low-Cost, Minimal-Transit Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- **Morning:** Nijo Castle exterior area or nearby shrine/temple
- **Afternoon:** Kyoto Imperial Palace Park or a free garden walk
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/ee/Shugaku-in_Imperial_Villa_-_Lower_Garden_a.JPG Alt=Afternoon:** Kyoto Imperial Palace Park or a free garden walk, Kyoto, Japan
- **Evening:** Simple dinner near hotel, rest night
- **Walking:** about 4–6 km
- **Cost level:** Low
- **Why this works:** keeps transit and admissions down while giving your budget room for the rest of the trip

### Day 4: Food Market + Central Kyoto Temples
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Morning:** Nishiki Market food visit
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning:** Nishiki Market food visit, Kyoto, Japan
- **Afternoon:** Teramachi/Shinkyogoku browsing, then a nearby temple stop
- **Evening:** Pontocho or river area for a casual dinner
- **Walking:** about 6–8 km
- **Cost level:** Medium
- **Food stop:** This is your one dedicated market day
Media: Alt=Food stop:** This is your one dedicated market day, Kyoto, Japan

### Day 5: Northern Kyoto Garden and Temple Pair
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Kinkaku-ji
- **Afternoon:** Ryoan-ji garden and nearby temple area
- **Evening:** Final dinner in central Kyoto
- **Walking:** about 7–10 km
- **Cost level:** Medium

## Budget Snapshot for 5 Days

| Category | Planned Range | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Lodging | 55,000–80,000 JPY | Mid-range hotel or apartment for 4 nights |
| Food | 35,000–50,000 JPY | Mix of cafés, set meals, and one market visit |
| Local transit | 8,000–14,000 JPY | Bus/subway + occasional taxi |
| Admissions | 18,000–28,000 JPY | Temples, gardens, and a few paid sites |
| Buffer | 15,000–20,000 JPY | Snacks, extras, weather changes |
| **Total** | **131,000–192,000 JPY** | Stay near the lower-middle range to remain under budget |

## Best Itinerary Visualization

### Day-by-Day Bar Chart Idea
Use a **stacked horizontal bar chart** for each day with three activity types:

- **Temple / cultural time**
- **Garden / scenic time**
- **Food / market / rest time**

Suggested chart structure:
- **X-axis:** hours spent
- **Y-axis:** Day 1 to Day 5
- **Colors:**
  - Temple = deep red
  - Garden = green
  - Food/Rest = amber
- **Goal:** show that Day 3 is the lightest and Day 1/2/5 are the most temple/garden focused

Suggested time split by day:
| Day | Temple/Culture | Garden/Scenic | Food/Rest |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Day 1 | 5.0 hrs | 1.5 hrs | 1.5 hrs |
| Day 2 | 3.5 hrs | 3.0 hrs | 1.5 hrs |
| Day 3 | 2.0 hrs | 2.0 hrs | 3.0 hrs |
| Day 4 | 2.5 hrs | 1.5 hrs | 3.0 hrs |
| Day 5 | 4.0 hrs | 2.5 hrs | 1.0 hrs |

### Map-Style Layout Concept
Use a **simple Kyoto zone map** with color-coded pins and a route line:

- **East Kyoto:** Kiyomizu-dera, Gion, Kodai-ji
- **West Kyoto:** Arashiyama, Tenryu-ji, Okochi Sanso
- **Central Kyoto:** Nishiki Market, Kyoto Station area, Imperial Palace
- **North Kyoto:** Kinkaku-ji, Ryoan-ji, Nijo Castle

Recommended visual style:
- **One map panel per day**
- **Numbered pins** for stops in visit order
- **Walking segments** shown as short dashed lines
- **Transit segments** shown as solid colored lines
- **Budget badge** on each day card: Low / Medium
